posts.title: Building Synapse & Preparing for SIH 2026 at CVR Campus
posts.author: Vishnu Teja
posts.excerpt: How our team kicked off our Smart India Hackathon project right here in CVR's CSE Lab 3.
posts.full:
When the Smart India Hackathon internal round was announced at CVR College of Engineering, my team and I knew we wanted to build something practical. We spent evenings in CSE Lab 3 brainstorming solutions for campus resource management.

Using vanilla JavaScript, asynchronous requests, and a clean interface made our prototype fast and modular.

posts.title: Behind the Scenes of CIENCIA: Organizing Web-A-Thon 2026
posts.author: Vishnu Teja
posts.excerpt: A quick look into how our student team organizes CVR's annual technical fest Web-A-Thon.
posts.full:
CIENCIA is when CVR College of Engineering buzzes with the highest energy. Teams arrive at our Ibrahimpatnam campus for robotics, paper presentations, and coding marathons.

For Web-A-Thon, we built an interactive portal where participants could view updates seamlessly without page reloads.
